notes.title: "Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer" is now available!
notes.notes:
"Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer" (Publisher: Waku Waku Games) was released today.
The game is available in Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2597260/_beyond/


"Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer" is the full version of the novel game "Natsuno-Kanata" which was released for free on Steam in August 2022.
The basic design of the game is the same as the original version. Players will be able to communicate with "Natsuno" through the computer, and will be able to communicate with Natsuno and progress through the story with her.

"Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer" is based on the original version, which is currently available for free.

The game has been completely redesigned in Unity.
The game engine, Unity, has been adopted to improve the game play environment. For example, the original version required the use of a keyboard to input instructions, but "Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer" is fully controller-compatible. For example, the original version required the use of the keyboard to input instructions, but "Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer" is fully controller-compatible, and frequently-used instructions can now be selected by command selection. Of course, direct input using the keyboard is also possible.

What is added in "Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer"
While the original version of the game has been updated to include additional characters and stories, beyond will add a new character and story.

In addition, the background music has been replaced and a new song has been added,
The new version of "Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer" adds a new character and a new storyline to the game.

Addition of one new character
New stills (multiple stills)
New insert song sung by Shiika, who sang the theme song.
New BGM (replacements/multiple songs)

notes.title: "natsuno-kanata" Content Update Completed !
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "natsuno-kanata".

With ver. 1.2.10, we are pleased to announce that all updates scheduled for "natsuno-kanata" have been completed,
We are pleased to announce that all scheduled updates for "natsuno-kanata" have been completed with the release of ver1.2.10.
It has been about a year since the full release and nearly two years since the start of early access, so thank you very much for your support.
Thanks to the many people who have played the game, we are now ready for the last update.
For those of you who have not yet played the game, we hope you will take this opportunity to do so.

This will be the last update related to the contents.
We will continue to work on fixing bugs as needed.

We will consider porting "natsuno-kanata" to other platforms and localizing it in other languages.
We will also be releasing the soundtrack, which has not yet been made public, on YouTube.
Please follow our official Twitter account and stay tuned.
[url=https://twitter.com/natsu_no_kanata]https://twitter.com/natsu_no_kanata[/url]

Even though the update is over, their journey will continue.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: New Text ADV "Piano at 5 a.m." Released!
notes.notes:
[h3]Kazuhide Oka, who worked on planning/production/scenario for "natsuno-kanata", has released his new text ADV "Piano at 5 a.m."![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2378460/_/

In the early hours of the morning, around 5 a.m., the town is sometimes shrouded in a thick fog.
Playing the Piano at 5 a.m." is a short text adventure game.
A girl leaves her house at 5 a.m. and encounters various things in the fog.
She aims for 8 a.m. while adjusting the four parameters of "sleepiness," "thirst," "madness," and "recharge," which increase or decrease depending on the choices she makes.
The game is like a short story in which a girl wandering in the fog encounters and remembers various things.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2378460/_/][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FtbS4tqaYAAyFnO?format=jpg&name=large[/img][/url]

We hope you enjoy it as well!

We hope you enjoy!

notes.title: natsuno-kanata Full Release
notes.notes:
We have released the early access version of natsuno-kanata since August 5, 2021.
We are pleased to announce the release of the full version (ver. 1.0.0) of the text adventure game natsuno-kanata.

The main additions in the full version are as follows.
Addition of a scenario up to the conclusion of the game.
Addition of two new character episodes.
Additional locations, items, etc.


Thank you to everyone who played the Early Access version.
We hope you continue to enjoy the full version.


Although the early access period has ended, we will continue to update natsuno-kanata regularly.
In addition to adjustments and bug fixes, we plan to add episodes that can be viewed after the ending.
Detailed updates will be released at a later date.

We look forward to your continued feedback and requests.

summer after the Early Access is over because it is a text-heavy game.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and thank you for
your understanding.

We are very grateful for all the requests for localization in the threads.

If you have any localization requests, please continue to post them in
the threads.
We will consider them after the early access is over.

Thank you for your continued support of natsuno-kanata - beyond the summer.


Kazuhide Oka


-----------------------------------------------

ローカライズ対応につきまして

ナツノカナタのプレイいただきありがとうございます。
多数のご要望をいただいている、日本語以外の言語の対応、ローカライズにつきまして、
ご連絡させていただきます。


ナツノカナタのローカライズ対応は、早期アクセスの終了後に検討致します。
何分テキスト量の多いゲームですので、
日本語版を開発しながらのローカライズは現実的ではないと判断致しました。
大変ご不便おかけしますが、ご理解のほどよろしくお願い致します。

スレッド等にてローカライズのご要望いただいていることは大変ありがたく思っております。
早期アクセス終了後、検討の材料とさせていただきますので、
ローカライズのご要望は、今後ともスレッド等に書き込んでいただければと思います。


皆様のご要望のお応えできるよう制作を進めてまいりますので、
今後ともナツノカナタをよろしくお願い致します。


Kazuhide Oka
